name: Sarj AI
tagline: Review AI call history, transcripts, outcomes and analytics
description:
Connect Cline to [Sarj AI](https://sarj.ai), a platform for Arabic and English AI voice calls. Find recent calls, filter by status and date, inspect call details, read available transcripts, and review post-call analysis from your connected organization.

The hosted MCP server uses Streamable HTTP and OAuth; no local server is required. Call reads require `calls:read`. The production server also advertises call-management tools that require `calls:write`. Review the requested scopes and client tool approvals before authorizing. Transcript and analysis availability depends on call completion, processing and your organization's features.

See the [setup guide](https://platform-docs.sarj.ai/mcp-server), [client configurations](https://github.com/sarj-ai/mcp-integrations), and [synthetic walkthrough](https://drive.google.com/file/d/18fJpJIpPXIR2hOazZafatvEQFmsXpv7P/view). [Support](https://sarj.ai/contact) · [Privacy](https://sarj.ai/privacy) · [Terms](https://sarj.ai/terms).

install.notes: Requires an existing Sarj account with access to an organization. Complete OAuth and review the requested permissions. Sarj's current OAuth flow requires an account role that can create API credentials; ask your organization administrator if authorization is denied. The MIT license covers the public client configuration and documentation; hosted service access is governed by Sarj's terms.
